PresetName: The name this has in the game and in menus. It has to be different from everything else of the same kind.
CopyOf: Starts this as a copy of another one. Only the settings written here change; everything else comes from the original.
Description: The text shown in the buy menu.
Mass: How heavy it is, in kilograms. Heavier things are slower to push around, and a heavy unit jumps less high.
Health: How much damage it takes before it dies.
MaxHealth: The most health it can have. Health can only be raised up to this.
GoldValue: What it costs in the buy menu.
HitsMOs: Whether it knocks into other things (1) or passes through them (0).
GetsHitByMOs: Whether other things can hit it (1) or go straight through it (0).
AddToGroup: A shelf in the buy menu this appears on. A thing can be on several.
ScriptPath: A Lua script that makes this do extra things while the game runs.
FrameCount: How many pictures are in its sprite: a row of frames, such as the stages of an arm bending.
SpriteOffset: Moves the picture around the part's pivot, in pixels, without moving the part itself.
ParentOffset: Where on its parent this part is fixed, in pixels from the parent's centre.
JointOffset: The part's pivot: the spot on this part that sits at the fixing point, and that the part turns around.
DrawAfterParent: Drawn in front of the part it is fixed to (1), or behind it (0).
InheritsRotAngle: Turns with the part it is fixed to (1), or keeps pointing the same way (0).
InheritedRotAngleDegOffset: An extra turn, in degrees, on top of the angle it takes from its parent.
MaxLength: How far this arm or leg can stretch, in pixels. The longer it is, the further it reaches.
MoveSpeed: How fast the hand or foot moves to where it is going.
IdleOffset: Where the hand rests when it is holding nothing.
JointStrength: How hard a blow has to be to knock this part off.
RateOfFire: How many rounds it fires in a minute.
ReloadTime: How long a reload takes, in thousandths of a second (1000 is one second).
FullAuto: Keeps firing while the trigger is held (1), or fires once per press (0).
MuzzleOffset: Where shots come from, measured from the gun's centre, in pixels.
AddAttachable: A piece fixed to this one, such as a helmet or a pack.
AddInventory: Something this unit carries when it is bought.
AddDevice: A gun or tool this unit holds.
Head: The head of the unit. It is a part of its own, with its own picture.
FGArm: The front arm, nearest the camera, which holds the gun.
BGArm: The back arm, drawn behind the body.
FGLeg: The front leg, nearest the camera.
BGLeg: The back leg, drawn behind the body.
Jetpack: The jetpack on the unit's back.
SpriteFile: The picture this is drawn with.
FilePath: Where the picture or file is, inside a mod's folder.
